reviewed_contract.conclusion: Exact detail-ID guard runs before List projection and pretty-serializes the original Value by reference. It retains long/multiline text, nested objects/arrays, unknown fetched fields, exact cursor string values including whitespace/newlines, false flags, null cursors and empty nodes arrays. CommandOutput retains original data and command. List/search/attachments/team/project IDs do not match; they continue through the unchanged compact renderer. Singular mutation IDs remain on unchanged fallback.

reviewed_contract.conclusion: This changes display of the fetched Value only. Existing --full uses first:100 per extra connection and preserves pageInfo; page reads honor existing --limit/--after. It neither automatically exhausts pagination nor claims raw HTTP-byte/duplicate-key preservation or fields not fetched by GraphQL. JSON escapes preserve string values rather than flattening text or making a shell cursor command.
